Rashi on Pesachim 118b:11:1.hebrew: אומות העולם מאי עבידתייהו - לשבוחי משום דגבר עלינו חסדו? הא עלן לשבוחי:
Rashi on Pesachim 118b:11:1.english: What are the nations of the world doing - To praise [God] because "His mercy is great toward us"? Surely it is upon us to praise [Him].

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:11:2.english: For the mighty acts and wonders - that you saw He did for me.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:14:1.english: And a reed - [This refers to] the congregation of Israel among the reeds in the forest.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:15:1.hebrew: חזיר מיער - זה אדום, שכתוב בה (שם ז) "אכלה ומדקה ושארא ברגלה רפסה", וזה דרכו של חזיר:
Rashi on Pesachim 118b:15:1.english: The pig out of the wood - This [refers to] Edom, concerning which it is written ([Daniel] 7): "It devoured and crushed, and trampled the rest with its feet," and this is the manner of a pig.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:16:1.hebrew: שכל מעשיה נכתבים בקולמוס אחד - כלו', פה אחד להם להרע:
Rashi on Pesachim 118b:16:1.english: All of whose actions are written with a single quill - That is to say, they have one mouth to do evil.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:17:1.english: Submitting himself [mitrapes] - Opening the palm [matir pas], [meaning] stretching out a hand.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:17:2.hebrew: ברצי - כלומר, מתנים עם ישראל לעשות רצונם בשוחד שהם מקבלים, ואין מקיימין דבריהם:
Rashi on Pesachim 118b:17:2.english: With pieces of [silver] - That is to say, [they] stipulate with Israel to do their will for the bribe that they receive, yet they do not fulfill their words.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:1:1.hebrew: ואקדיח מבחוץ - לשרוף את הזורקים אותן לתוך האור, דכתיב (דניאל ג): גובריא אילך די הסיקו לשדרך מישך ועבד נגו, קטיל הימון שביבא דנורא:
Rashi on Pesachim 118b:1:1.english: And I will burn [it] from the outside - to burn those who cast them into the fire, as it is written (Daniel 3): "Those men who brought up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, the flame of the fire slew them."

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:1:2.english: And the truth of the Lord [endures] forever - For He fulfilled His word to me and kept His promise to me, which He promised me, to rescue [some] of the descendants of Abraham.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:3:1.english: Whose master gave him a gift - Sustenance for the fish.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:6:1.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr>: כיון דנחיתו כוכבי שמיא עלייהו, נחיתו לאקורי נפשייהו בנחל קישון:
Rashi on Pesachim 118b:6:1.english: This is the reading: Since the stars of heaven descended upon them, they went down to cool themselves in the Kishon River.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:7:1.english: And the truth of the Lord endures forever - For He paid us our gifts from the army of Pharaoh, to sustain ourselves from it.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:8:1.english: Your children have made me - Because of the multitude of their sins in exile.

Rashi on Pesachim 118b:8:2.english: Like this rat that dwells in the foundations of houses - And this is [the meaning of] “the barren woman of the house” [akeret habayit].

Tosafot on Pesachim 118b:6:1.hebrew: מן שמים נלחמו הכוכבי' ממסילותם - במקומן היו עומדים וראשן מגיע עד לארץ, וכן פירש"י בנימוקי מקרא. ותימה: למ"ד בפ' מי שהיה (לעיל פסחים דף צד.) "כל העולם כולו תחת כוכב א' עומד" — האיך ירדו הכוכבים? הלא מאחד נתמלא העולם! י"ל דלא איירי אלא בכוכבים של גלגל, שהן מזלות קבועים; אבל שאר כוכבים קטנים הם:
Tosafot on Pesachim 118b:6:1.english: "From heaven they fought, the stars from their courses" - They stood in their place, and their top reached down to the earth; and so Rashi explained in [his] commentary on Scripture. And [this poses] a difficulty: according to the one who says in the chapter [entitled] Mi Shehayah (above, Pesachim 94a), "The entire world stands beneath a single star," how could the stars have descended? Surely the [entire] world would be filled by [even] one [star]! One can answer that [that statement] refers only to the stars of the [celestial] sphere, which are fixed constellations, whereas other stars are small.
